auditoria.erro: place/role: page is not hosted-only; it offers open-weight models (v5-text, v5-omni) with GGUF/MLX quantization for edge deployment and on-premises/VPC deployment, so place should include disk and the nota's 'sends notes to a third party' is overstated.

final.role: Multilingual embedding models via hosted API, cloud marketplaces or open-weight local deployment.
final.evidence: Top-performing multimodal multilingual long-context embeddings for search, RAG and agent applications. v5-text ... GGUF/MLX quantization for edge deployment.

auditoria.nota: Candidate embedding source for the hub's semantic search; open-weight GGUF models could keep client notes local instead of calling the paid API.
